title: The Microarchitecture of Intel, AMD and VIA CPUs
subtitle: An optimization guide for assembly programmers and compiler makers
author: Agner Fog
description: The third of Agner Fog's optimization manuals. A detailed reference on how modern x86 processors work internally — pipelines, out-of-order execution, branch prediction, caches, and execution units — for every major microarchitecture generation.
